tips.label: 先看主詞與花費內容
tips.text: 人花時間或金錢用 spend；人付錢用 pay；物品的價錢用 cost；It 開頭表達花時間做事用 take。

tips.label: 動作接法
tips.text: spend + 時間／金錢 + V-ing；It takes + 人 + 時間 + to V；It costs + 人 + 金錢 + to V。

tips.label: 問時間、問金錢
tips.text: How long 問花多久；How much 問花多少錢。問句用了 do、does、did，後面動詞要恢復原形。

notes.title: spend：人花時間或金錢
notes.rule: 人 + spend(s)/spent + 時間／金錢 + V-ing；人 + spend(s)/spent + 時間／金錢 + on + 名詞
notes.description: spend 的主詞通常是人。後面若是動作，用 V-ing；若是事物，用 on 加名詞。不要把 spend 的 V-ing 寫成 to V。
examples: We spent two hours visiting the temple.
She spends thirty minutes on her homework every day.
Dad spent five hundred dollars buying an umbrella.
Dad spent five hundred dollars on an umbrella.

notes.title: take：花時間做事
notes.rule: It takes/took + 人 + 時間 + to V；V-ing + takes/took + 人 + 時間
notes.description: take 在本課用來表示花時間。It 句型後面的動作用 to V，人的代名詞用受格 me、him、her、us、them。也能把動名詞片語放到句首作主詞；整件事視為單數，現在式用 takes。人可以省略，如 It takes ten minutes to walk there.
examples: It took us an hour to reach the town.
It takes her ten minutes to print the photos.
Walking to the temple takes me twenty minutes.

notes.title: cost：事物花費金錢
notes.rule: 事物 + cost(s)/cost + 人 + 金錢；It costs/cost + 人 + 金錢 + to V
notes.description: 說某物價錢多少時，用事物作主詞；不要直接用買東西的人作 cost 的主詞。一般現在式的單數主詞用 costs，複數用 cost；過去式仍是 cost，不是 costed。也能用 It costs/cost ... to V 說明做某事需要的金額。
examples: The ticket costs two hundred dollars.
These tickets cost six hundred dollars.
The camera cost me three thousand dollars yesterday.
It cost us four hundred dollars to visit the zoo.

notes.title: pay：人付錢買東西
notes.rule: 人 + pay(s)/paid + 金錢 + for + 事物；人 + pay(s)/paid + 帳單
notes.description: pay 的主詞是付款的人，過去式是 paid。付多少錢買某物用 pay + 金額 + for + 事物；繳帳單可直接說 pay the bill，不需要再加 for。
examples: I paid three hundred dollars for the umbrella.
She pays the phone bill every month.
We did not pay for the tickets.

notes.title: How long：問花費時間
notes.rule: How long + do/does/did + 人 + spend + V-ing?；How long + does/did + it + take + 人 + to V?
notes.description: How long 對應時間長度，例如 twenty minutes 或 two hours。注意 spend 問句用 V-ing，take 的 It 問句用 to V。助動詞 did 已表示過去，後面仍用 spend、take。
examples: How long did you spend printing the photos?
I spent ten minutes printing them.
How long does it take her to get to the city?
It takes her an hour to get there.

notes.title: How much：問花費金額
notes.rule: How much + do/does/did + 人 + spend + on + 事物?；How much + does/do/did + 事物 + cost?；How much + do/does/did + 人 + pay + for + 事物?
notes.description: How much 對應金額，例如 two hundred dollars。判斷助動詞時要看時態與主詞：the ticket 用 does，the tickets 用 do，過去事件用 did。也可說 How much did it cost you to buy the ticket?
examples: How much did you spend on the package?
How much does this umbrella cost?
How much do these photos cost?
How much did she pay for the ticket?
How much did it cost you to send the package?

notes.title: 同義句轉換：時間
notes.rule: 人 + spend + 時間 + V-ing ↔ It takes + 人 + 時間 + to V
notes.description: 意思相同，句型中的主詞與動詞形式會改變。轉換時保留原來的時間、做事的人與時態；原句是過去式，兩邊都要用過去式。
examples: We spent thirty minutes cleaning the room.
It took us thirty minutes to clean the room.
Cleaning the room took us thirty minutes.

notes.title: 同義句轉換：金錢
notes.rule: 人 + spend + 金錢 + on + 物 ↔ 物 + cost + 人 + 金錢 ↔ 人 + pay + 金錢 + for + 物
notes.description: 三種句型可以描述同一次購買。先找付款的人、購買的物品與金額，再依主詞選 spend、cost 或 pay；不要只看到 dollars 就選同一個動詞。
examples: Amy spent two hundred dollars on the bag.
The bag cost Amy two hundred dollars.
Amy paid two hundred dollars for the bag.

notes.title: 現在式、過去式與助動詞
notes.description: every day、usually 常提示習慣，yesterday、last night 常提示過去。現在式單數第三人稱要加 s；疑問句與否定句已有 does 或 did，後面的動詞不能再加 s 或改成過去式。
examples: He spends an hour reading every night.
He spent an hour reading last night.
Did he spend an hour reading last night?
She does not pay for lunch at school.

quiz.question: The visitors spent twenty minutes ___ for the bus outside the temple.
quiz.hint: spent 後面接時間與動作時，動作要用 V-ing，因此選 waiting。

quiz.question: It took us half an hour ___ the missing umbrella.
quiz.hint: It took + 人 + 時間 後面用 to V，表示做某事花多少時間，因此用 to find。

quiz.question: The photos ___ me eighty dollars when I printed them yesterday.
quiz.hint: yesterday 表過去；cost 的過去式仍是 cost，不能寫成 costed，也不能用現在式 costs。

quiz.question: I ___ three hundred dollars for this bag at the department store yesterday.
quiz.hint: yesterday 表過去；人付錢買東西用 pay 的過去式 paid。

quiz.question: A: ___ did you spend visiting the city? B: About two days.
quiz.hint: 回答 two days 是時間長度，因此用 How long；How much 問金額，How often 問頻率。

quiz.question: My sister usually ___ fifteen minutes paying bills online.
quiz.hint: usually 表習慣；主詞 My sister 是單數第三人稱，一般現在式用 spends。

quiz.question: A: How much did the umbrella ___? B: Two hundred dollars.
quiz.hint: 問句已有 did，後面用原形 cost；不能加 s、加 ed 或改成 V-ing。

quiz.question: It ___ me ten minutes to walk to the convenience store every morning.
quiz.hint: every morning 表習慣，主詞 It 是單數，一般現在式用 takes。

quiz.question: We spent three hundred dollars ___ tickets for the temple tour.
quiz.hint: spend + 金額 後面若接購買的動作，要用 V-ing，因此選 buying。

quiz.question: A: How much did you ___ for the train ticket? B: Five hundred dollars.
quiz.hint: 主詞 you 是付款的人，且金錢問句搭配 for the train ticket，要用 pay。

quiz.question: My brother did not ___ any time looking for the restroom because he knew where it was.
quiz.hint: did not 後接原形動詞；spend + 時間 + V-ing 表示花時間做事，因此用 spend。

quiz.question: It took ___ forty minutes to reach the small town.
quiz.hint: It took + 人 + 時間 中，人是受詞，he 要改成受格 him；本句沒有反身代名詞的用法。

quiz.question: A: ___ did the camera cost you? B: Six thousand dollars.
quiz.hint: 回答是 six thousand dollars，問的是花費金額，因此用 How much。

quiz.question: Walking from the hotel to the temple ___ us twenty minutes every day.
quiz.hint: Walking ... 是一整件事，動名詞片語作主詞視為單數；every day 提示現在習慣，用 takes。

quiz.question: A: How long did the foreigners ___ traveling around the island? B: A week.
quiz.hint: 主詞是人 the foreigners，後面接 traveling，問花費時間要用 spend。

quiz.question: The two museum tickets ___ four hundred dollars in total. That is their price today.
quiz.hint: 主詞 The two museum tickets 是複數，且說的是今天的價格，一般現在式用 cost。

quiz.question: My father ___ the phone bill last night.
quiz.hint: last night 表過去；pay the bill 表繳帳單，pay 的過去式是 paid。

quiz.question: A: How long did it take you ___ those photos? B: Ten minutes.
quiz.hint: How long did it take + 人 後面接 to V，表示做這件事花多久，因此用 to print。

quiz.question: The visitors ___ two hours in the department store yesterday.
quiz.hint: yesterday 表過去；人花時間待在某處用 spend，過去式是 spent。

quiz.question: It costs us fifty dollars ___ a package from this store.
quiz.hint: It costs + 人 + 金額 後面用 to V 說明花錢做什麼，因此用 to send。

quiz.question: A: How much does your sister ___ on bus tickets each week? B: Two hundred dollars.
quiz.hint: 問句已有 does，後面的 spend 用原形；不能再加 s 或用過去式。

quiz.question: I spent twenty minutes reading the map. In other words, it ___ me twenty minutes to read it.
quiz.hint: 原句 spent 是過去式；改成 It ... to V 仍要保留過去時間，所以用 took。

quiz.question: A: How much ___ these umbrellas cost? B: They cost three hundred dollars each.
quiz.hint: these umbrellas 是複數，cost 是一般動詞，現在式問句用 do；不能用 does 或 be 動詞。

quiz.question: Our teacher ___ an hour helping the foreign visitor yesterday.
quiz.hint: 主詞 Our teacher 是人，後面是時間 an hour 與 helping，要用 spent。

quiz.question: Amy does not ___ for her lunch at school.
quiz.hint: does not 已標示現在式與單數主詞，後面的動詞恢復原形 pay。

quiz.question: The tour bus ticket ___ five hundred dollars. That is its price today.
quiz.hint: 主詞 The tour bus ticket 是單數，描述目前的價格，現在式用 costs。

quiz.question: A: How long does it ___ you to reach the city by train? B: An hour.
quiz.hint: 問句已有 does，後面的動詞要用原形 take；不能用 takes 或 took。

quiz.question: My parents spent two days ___ in the small town.
quiz.hint: spent + 時間 後面接動作時用 V-ing，因此選 staying。

quiz.question: Dad paid six hundred dollars for the umbrella. In other words, the umbrella ___ Dad six hundred dollars.
quiz.hint: 改成物品 the umbrella 作主詞，表達金額要用 cost；pay、spend 通常用人作主詞，take 在本課表示時間。

quiz.question: A: ___ does it take to get to the airport on the metro? B: About forty minutes.
quiz.hint: 回答 forty minutes 是花費的時間長度，所以用 How long。

quiz.question: I ___ two hundred dollars for the visitor's ticket yesterday.
quiz.hint: 主詞是人 I，後面是金額與 for + 物品，應選 pay 的過去式 paid。

quiz.question: It took us an hour ___ the beautiful scenery around the lake.
quiz.hint: It took + 人 + 時間 後面要接 to V，因此用 to enjoy。

quiz.question: A: How much did you ___ on the gifts for your foreign friends? B: A thousand dollars.
quiz.hint: 主詞 you 是人，金額問句接 on + 物品，使用 spend；pay 的購物句型搭配 for。

quiz.question: Printing all these photos ___ me an hour yesterday.
quiz.hint: yesterday 表過去；動名詞片語 Printing ... 作主詞，用 take 的過去式 took 表示花時間。

quiz.question: How much did it cost your family ___ around the island last summer?
quiz.hint: How much did it cost + 人 後面用 to V 表示花錢做什麼，因此選 to travel。

quiz.question: We did not ___ for the comfortable seats because they were free.
quiz.hint: did not 後面接原形 pay；即使事情發生在過去，也不能再用 paid。

quiz.question: A: How long did your brother spend ___ the bills? B: About five minutes.
quiz.hint: How long did ... spend 後面的動作要用 V-ing；pay bills 是繳帳單，因此用 paying。

quiz.question: My sister ___ three hundred dollars for her bus pass every month.
quiz.hint: every month 表習慣，主詞 My sister 是單數第三人稱，pay 要加 s 成為 pays。

quiz.question: It took the visitors two hours to reach the temple. They ___ two hours getting there.
quiz.hint: 換成人 They 作主詞，後面接時間與 getting，改用 spent，並保留過去式。

quiz.question: A: How much ___ this camera cost? B: It costs eight thousand dollars.
quiz.hint: this camera 是單數，回答 costs 表現在價格；一般動詞的問句用 does。

quiz.question: The new chair ___ me two thousand dollars last week.
quiz.hint: last week 表過去；cost 的過去式不加 ed，仍是 cost。

quiz.question: A: How long did it ___ your friend to print the map? B: Five minutes.
quiz.hint: did 後面用原形 take，不能再用過去式 took，也不能加 s。

quiz.question: The visitors spent a lot of money ___ photos of the koalas.
quiz.hint: spend + 金錢 後接動作時，用 V-ing；因此用 buying，不能用 to buy。

quiz.question: We paid five hundred dollars for the tickets. We ___ five hundred dollars on them.
quiz.hint: 同義改寫保留人作主詞與金額，後面是 on them，使用 spent + 金額 + on + 事物。

quiz.question: A: ___ did you pay for the comfortable shoes? B: Nine hundred dollars.
quiz.hint: 回答 nine hundred dollars 是金額，pay for 問花多少錢，用 How much。

quiz.question: It ___ us an hour to find the lost package yesterday.
quiz.hint: yesterday 表過去；It ... + 人 + 時間 + to V 用 take 的過去式 took。

quiz.question: How long ___ it usually take your mother to pay the bills online?
quiz.hint: usually 表習慣；主詞 it 是單數，take 是一般動詞，問句用 does。

quiz.question: I spent thirty minutes drawing a map. It took me thirty minutes ___ the map.
quiz.hint: spend ... V-ing 改成 It took ... to V，動作 drawing 要改為 to draw。

quiz.question: It cost ___ three hundred dollars to send the package.
quiz.hint: It cost + 人 + 金額 中的人作受詞，we 要用受格 us；our、ours 都是所有格形式。

quiz.question: A: How much did you ___ for the umbrella that day? B: Only a hundred dollars.
quiz.hint: 問句已有 did，後面的 pay 必須用原形；不能因為 that day 是過去就再用 paid。

vocab.sentence: I paid the bill at a convenience store.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我在便利商店繳了帳單。

vocab.sentence: It took me five minutes to print the photos.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我花了 5 分鐘列印照片。

vocab.sentence: These photos cost me fifty dollars.

vocab.sentence: Of course, I can help you print it.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 當然，我可以幫你列印。

vocab.sentence: How much did you pay for the book?

vocab.sentence: The umbrella cost me two hundred dollars.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這把雨傘花了我 200 元。

vocab.sentence: I spent ten dollars on this pen.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我買這支筆花了 10 元。

vocab.sentence: She sent a package to her brother yesterday.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 她昨天寄了一個包裹給哥哥。

vocab.sentence: It took me ten minutes to send the package.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我花了 10 分鐘寄包裹。

vocab.sentence: Dad paid five hundred dollars for dinner.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 爸爸花了 500 元吃晚餐。

vocab.sentence: Mom paid the phone bill this morning.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 媽媽今天早上繳了電話費。

vocab.sentence: The price of this bike is too high.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這輛腳踏車的價格太高了。

vocab.sentence: The price of the bag is low.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這個袋子的價格很低。

vocab.sentence: I spend thirty minutes reading every day.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我每天花 30 分鐘閱讀。

vocab.sentence: This pencil costs fifty cents.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這支鉛筆的價格是 50 分。

vocab.sentence: This bag is cheap, but it is useful.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這個袋子很便宜，但很實用。

vocab.sentence: Don't worry about the money.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 別擔心錢的事。

vocab.sentence: I paid three hundred dollars for this umbrella.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我買這把雨傘花了 300 元。

vocab.sentence: It is convenient to pay bills here.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 在這裡繳帳單很方便。

vocab.sentence: We did not travel far yesterday.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們昨天沒有到很遠的地方旅行。

vocab.sentence: It takes me ten minutes to walk home.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我走路回家要花 10 分鐘。

vocab.sentence: The restroom is next to the store.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 洗手間在商店旁邊。

vocab.sentence: We spent two days in this town.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們在這座城鎮待了 2 天。

vocab.sentence: We stayed in Taiwan for a week.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們在臺灣待了 1 週。

vocab.sentence: They prayed for their sick friend.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 他們為生病的朋友祈禱。

vocab.sentence: It took us an hour to reach the temple.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們花了 1 小時到達寺廟。

vocab.sentence: Mom spent two hours in the department store.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 媽媽在百貨公司待了 2 小時。

vocab.sentence: The foreigner asked me for help.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那位外國人向我求助。

vocab.sentence: Can you think of a cheaper way?
vocab.sentence_chinese: 你想得到更便宜的方法嗎？

vocab.sentence: We spent an hour watching the koalas.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們花了 1 小時看無尾熊。

vocab.sentence: We enjoyed the beautiful scenery on the trip.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們在旅途中欣賞了美麗的風景。

vocab.sentence: The beautiful photos draw visitors to Taiwan.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這些美麗的照片吸引遊客來臺灣。

vocab.sentence: Many visitors spent the night in this town.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 許多遊客在這座城鎮過夜。

vocab.sentence: She spent a year in a foreign country.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 她在外國待了 1 年。

vocab.sentence: We spent a month traveling around Taiwan.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們花了 1 個月環臺旅行。

vocab.sentence: It took us two hours to reach the city.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們花了 2 小時抵達這座城市。

vocab.sentence: This watch is too expensive for me.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這支手錶對我來說太貴了。

vocab.sentence: We spent three days in the city.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們在這座城市待了 3 天。

vocab.sentence: You can sit anywhere in this room.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 你可以坐在這個房間裡的任何地方。

vocab.sentence: This chair is comfortable.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這張椅子很舒適。

vocab.sentence: We have little time to visit the temple.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們幾乎沒有時間參觀寺廟。

vocab.sentence: The hotel is cheap. Besides, it is comfortable.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這間旅館很便宜。此外，它也很舒適。

vocab.sentence: Most visitors travel around the city by bus.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 大多數遊客搭公車遊覽這座城市。

vocab.sentence: Someone paid for our lunch.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 有人付了我們的午餐錢。

vocab.sentence: Can you lend me a hand with these bags?
vocab.sentence_chinese: 你可以幫我拿這些袋子嗎？

vocab.sentence: The rich man spent a lot on his car.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那位有錢人花了很多錢買車。

vocab.sentence: We are proud of our school.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們以自己的學校為榮。

phrases.sentence: Of course!
phrases.sentence_chinese: 當然可以！

phrases.sentence: We were in a convenience store.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我們那時在便利商店。

phrases.sentence: My friend sends packages to me every week.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我的朋友每週寄包裹給我。

phrases.sentence: Remember to get tickets by tomorrow.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 記得明天以前去買票。

phrases.sentence: Lucy paid bills last Sunday.
phrases.sentence_chinese: Lucy 上個星期日付了帳單。

phrases.sentence: You don't have to get up early every day.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 你不必每天早起。

phrases.sentence: No worries. All of us can help you.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 不用擔心。我們全都能幫你。

phrases.sentence: The library is not far from my home.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 圖書館離我家不遠。

phrases.sentence: Good idea!
phrases.sentence_chinese: 好主意！

phrases.sentence: Jenny thought of a good idea and discussed it for a long time.
phrases.sentence_chinese: Jenny 想到了一個好主意，並討論了很久。

phrases.sentence: The picture draws me to the beautiful beach.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 這張圖片吸引我前往那片美麗的海灘。

phrases.sentence: Jerry went traveling around the island by bike.
phrases.sentence_chinese: Jerry 騎腳踏車環島旅行。

phrases.sentence: Mia goes to work by bus every day.
phrases.sentence_chinese: Mia 每天搭公車上班。

phrases.sentence: We can go to the airport on the metro.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我們可以搭地鐵去機場。

phrases.sentence: What's more, living in the country is safe.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 此外，住在鄉下很安全。

phrases.sentence: Don't worry about getting lost because we have a map.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 別擔心迷路，因為我們有地圖。

phrases.sentence: We are proud of our son.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我們以兒子為榮。

phrases.sentence: My friend always lends me a hand when I'm in trouble.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 當我遇到困難時，我的朋友總是幫助我。

grammar.sentence: We spent two hours visiting the old temple.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們花了 2 小時參觀那座古老的寺廟。

grammar.sentence_chinese: 我花了 10 分鐘列印這些照片。

grammar.sentence: The umbrella cost her two hundred dollars yesterday.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這把雨傘昨天花了她 200 元。

grammar.sentence: How much does this comfortable chair cost you?

grammar.sentence: My brother spends an hour reading every evening.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我弟弟每天晚上花 1 小時閱讀。

grammar.sentence: It takes us twenty minutes to reach the city.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們花 20 分鐘抵達這座城市。

grammar.sentence: She paid the phone bill at the convenience store.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 她在便利商店繳了電話費。

grammar.sentence: How much did you spend on the package?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你花了多少錢在那個包裹上？

grammar.sentence: Walking to the department store takes me thirty minutes.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 走路到百貨公司要花我 30 分鐘。

grammar.sentence: The visitors spent a week traveling around Taiwan.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 遊客們花了 1 週環臺旅行。

grammar.sentence: It cost us a thousand dollars to stay here.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 住在這裡花了我們 1,000 元。

grammar.sentence: How much did she pay for the umbrella?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 她買那把雨傘花了多少錢？

grammar.sentence: My father did not spend much money today.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我爸爸今天沒有花很多錢。

grammar.sentence: It took the foreigner an hour to get here.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那位外國人花了 1 小時到這裡。

grammar.sentence: The photo cost me fifty dollars last week.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那張照片上週花了我 50 元。

grammar.sentence: They paid six hundred dollars for these gifts.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 他們買這些禮物花了 600 元。

grammar.sentence: How long does it take you to get home?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你回家要花多久？

grammar.sentence: We spent thirty minutes looking for the restroom.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們花了 30 分鐘找洗手間。

grammar.sentence: It costs eighty dollars to send this package.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 寄這個包裹要花 80 元。

grammar.sentence: My mother pays the bills online every month.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我媽媽每個月都在線上繳帳單。

grammar.sentence: Did you spend two days in that town?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你在那座城鎮待了 2 天嗎？

grammar.sentence: It took her ten minutes to find the map.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 她花了 10 分鐘找到地圖。

grammar.sentence: How much do these train tickets cost you?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這些火車票要花你多少錢？

grammar.sentence: My sister spent three hundred dollars buying this bag.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我姊姊買這個袋子花了 300 元。

grammar.sentence: We did not pay for the temple tour.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們沒有付錢參加那個寺廟導覽。

grammar.sentence: Getting to the airport took us an hour.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 到機場花了我們 1 小時。

grammar.sentence: How long did they spend enjoying the scenery?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 他們花了多久欣賞風景？

grammar.sentence: It cost him two hundred dollars to buy the book.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 他買那本書花了 200 元。

cloze_quiz.question: We can buy snacks and pay bills at the ___ on the corner.
cloze_quiz.hint: convenience store 是便利商店；能買點心和繳帳單是線索。

cloze_quiz.question: Please ___ this photo on paper so I can put it on the wall.
cloze_quiz.hint: print 是列印；on paper 和放到牆上說明要把照片印出來。

cloze_quiz.question: Dad took a ___ of us with his camera.
cloze_quiz.hint: photo 是照片；took 和 camera 是拍照的線索。

cloze_quiz.question: A: May I borrow your pen? B: ___! Here you are.
cloze_quiz.hint: of course 表當然；後面把筆交給對方，表示同意借出。

cloze_quiz.question: I want to know ___ this bike costs, so I can bring enough money.
cloze_quiz.hint: how much 問多少錢；costs 和 enough money 提供金額線索。

cloze_quiz.question: These two tickets ___ three hundred dollars in total.
cloze_quiz.hint: cost 表花費金錢；主詞是票券，後面接總價。

cloze_quiz.question: One US ___ is equal to one hundred cents.
cloze_quiz.hint: dollar 是元；one hundred cents 等於一元。

cloze_quiz.question: Please ___ this package to my aunt by mail.
cloze_quiz.hint: send 是寄送；to my aunt 與 by mail 表示郵寄給阿姨。

cloze_quiz.question: The delivery driver brought a ___ with my new shoes inside.
cloze_quiz.hint: package 是包裹；送貨員送來、裡面裝著鞋子是線索。

cloze_quiz.question: You can ___ for your lunch with cash or a card.
cloze_quiz.hint: pay 是付款；cash or a card 是付款方式。

cloze_quiz.question: The waiter brought our ___ after we finished dinner.
cloze_quiz.hint: bill 是帳單；用餐完由服務生送來供結帳。

cloze_quiz.question: The ___ on the tag tells me how much the bag costs.
cloze_quiz.hint: price 是價格；how much the bag costs 是直接線索。

cloze_quiz.question: The price is very ___, so I can buy it with just a little money.
cloze_quiz.hint: low 表低的；只要少量金錢就買得起，表示價格低。

cloze_quiz.question: I ___ thirty minutes reading English every evening.
cloze_quiz.hint: spend 表花費時間；人作主詞，接時間和 reading。

cloze_quiz.question: A dollar has one hundred cents. This candy costs just one ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: cent 是分；前句說明貨幣單位，後句問糖果價格。

cloze_quiz.question: This pen is ___; it costs only five dollars.
cloze_quiz.hint: cheap 是便宜的；only five dollars 表示價格很低。

cloze_quiz.question: Don't ___ about the test. You have studied hard.
cloze_quiz.hint: worry about 表擔心；已認真讀書，因此安慰對方別擔心考試。

cloze_quiz.question: It is raining. Take an ___ to keep yourself dry.
cloze_quiz.hint: umbrella 是雨傘；下雨時用來避免淋濕。

cloze_quiz.question: The store is next door and open all day, so shopping there is ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: convenient 是方便的；就在隔壁且全天營業是方便購物的線索。

cloze_quiz.question: The school is next door, so we do not have to walk ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: far 表遠；學校就在隔壁，所以不用走很遠。

cloze_quiz.question: How long does it ___ to walk to the station?
cloze_quiz.hint: take 在此表示花費時間；How long 與 it ... to walk 是線索。

cloze_quiz.question: I need to use the toilet. Where is the ___?
cloze_quiz.hint: restroom 是洗手間；use the toilet 是直接線索。

cloze_quiz.question: My grandfather lives in a small ___ with only two streets and a few shops.
cloze_quiz.hint: town 是城鎮；有街道和商店、可供居民生活是線索。

cloze_quiz.question: We will ___ at this hotel for two nights before leaving.
cloze_quiz.hint: stay 是停留；在旅館住兩晚後才離開。

cloze_quiz.question: They ___ for their sick grandmother every night.
cloze_quiz.hint: pray 是祈禱；pray for someone 可表為生病的家人祈禱。

cloze_quiz.question: People burn incense and pray in this ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: temple 是寺廟；燒香和祈禱是線索。

cloze_quiz.question: This ___ has ten floors of shops selling clothes, shoes, and furniture.
cloze_quiz.hint: department store 是百貨公司；多個樓層販售各類商品是線索。

cloze_quiz.question: Mr. Brown is a ___ in Taiwan because he comes from another country.
cloze_quiz.hint: foreigner 是外國人；because 後面說他來自另一個國家。

cloze_quiz.question: We need a new idea. Can you ___ a better way to do this?
cloze_quiz.hint: think of 是想到；need a new idea 與 a better way 表示構思辦法。

cloze_quiz.question: A ___ is an Australian animal that eats eucalyptus leaves.
cloze_quiz.hint: koala 是無尾熊；澳洲與吃尤加利葉是線索。

cloze_quiz.question: We stopped to enjoy the beautiful ___ of the mountains and lake.
cloze_quiz.hint: scenery 是風景；山與湖是自然景色。

cloze_quiz.question: The beautiful beaches ___ many visitors to this island every summer.
cloze_quiz.hint: draw 在本課表示吸引；draw visitors to a place 指吸引遊客到某地。

cloze_quiz.question: A ___ is someone who comes to see a person or a place for a short time.
cloze_quiz.hint: visitor 是訪客或遊客；短暫前來拜訪或參觀符合定義。

cloze_quiz.question: I live in Taiwan. Japan is a ___ country to me.
cloze_quiz.hint: foreign 是外國的；住在臺灣的人把日本視為外國。

cloze_quiz.question: I want to ___ around the world and see different countries.
cloze_quiz.hint: travel 是旅行；around the world 和看不同國家是線索。

cloze_quiz.question: We will leave at eight and ___ the station at nine.
cloze_quiz.hint: reach 是抵達；八點出發、九點到車站表示抵達時間。

cloze_quiz.question: This watch is too ___ for me; I don't have enough money to buy it.
cloze_quiz.hint: expensive 是昂貴的；沒有足夠的錢買它是線索。

cloze_quiz.question: Kaohsiung is a large ___ in southern Taiwan.
cloze_quiz.hint: city 是城市；高雄是臺灣南部的大城市。

cloze_quiz.question: There are no seat numbers. You may sit ___ you like.
cloze_quiz.hint: anywhere 表任何地方；沒有座位編號，可以自由選位。

cloze_quiz.question: This bed is soft and ___, so I sleep well in it.
cloze_quiz.hint: comfortable 是舒適的；柔軟且能睡得好是線索。

cloze_quiz.question: We have very ___ time before the bus leaves, so hurry up.
cloze_quiz.hint: little 表很少；公車快開了、必須趕快，表示剩下的時間少。

cloze_quiz.question: The hotel is cheap. ___, it is close to the station.
cloze_quiz.hint: besides 是此外；第二句補充旅館的另一個優點，而非轉折或替代。

cloze_quiz.question: Nine of the ten students walk to school, so ___ students in this group walk.
cloze_quiz.hint: most 是大多數的；10 人中有 9 人走路，表示大多數。

cloze_quiz.question: I heard a voice outside. There must be ___ at the door.
cloze_quiz.hint: someone 是某人；聽到說話聲，推知門外有人。

cloze_quiz.question: These boxes are too heavy for me. Can you ___ and help me carry them?
cloze_quiz.hint: lend a hand 是幫忙；後面 help me carry them 說明要幫忙搬箱子。

cloze_quiz.question: The man is very ___; he has millions of dollars.
cloze_quiz.hint: rich 是富有的；擁有數百萬元是線索。

cloze_quiz.question: You worked hard and won the race. You should ___ yourself.
cloze_quiz.hint: be proud of 是以……為榮；努力並贏得比賽是值得自豪的事。
